facts.fact: The digital transformation ministry's communique, reported 22 July 2026, says SIGMAP's programming phase is operational since early 2026 while tender-file management and electronic bid submission are in testing.
The ministry reports SIGMAP used by 200 contracting authorities and 91 procurement commissions with over 600 users, and 274 annual procurement plans and 179 annual purchasing plans published on it.

systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Transformation and Modernisation of the Administration

MRT.note: The document covers a procurement system for authorities, not services people complete online.
